description: This file is a code-behind for the UserProfile page in an ASP.NET WebForms application. It handles loading user profile information from a database and navigation between pages, based on user session status.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: A partial class for the UserProfile page, managing user profile display and page navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial loading of user profile data if the user is logged in; redirects to login page if not.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the dashboard page when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Intended to handle profile button click; currently commented out.

methods.name: NameTB_TextChanged
methods.description: Placeholder for handling changes in the Name textbox.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.

methods.name: coursesB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the user's taken courses page.
